office_does: The District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross misdemeanor cases and other limited-jurisdiction matters for all of Columbia County.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Kimberly (Kim) Boggs, appointed in 2022 and elected unopposed that year, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Columbia County District Court Judge since her 2022 appointment, with a general law practice in the county since 1994.
highlights: Appointed District Court Judge in 2022 and elected unopposed that year [S1][S4]
District Court judge pro tem 2002-2021; Superior Court commissioner (2022) and judge pro tem [S1]
Past president of the Walla Walla Bar Association [S1]
